search_log: Listed every Jazz Pharmaceuticals (CIK 0001232524) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older pages); took every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2020-07 to 2026-11 whose items include 2.02, 9.01 or 7.01 and fetched every non-primary .htm exhibit from each filing's index.json.

The product row was read from the first table of each quarterly release whose first cell starts with the brand (the 'Total revenues' table listing product sales, net by product); the current three-month column is the first figure. Unit is read from the table's own '(In thousands)' / '(In millions)' header: thousands through the 2025Q4 release, millions from the 2026Q1 release.
Each quarter's own release reports it as current; no prior-year columns used.

Line is 'Rylaze' through the 2023Q4 release and 'Rylaze/Enrylaze' from the 2024Q1 release (Enrylaze is the EU trade name); the 2024Q1 release prints the prior-year quarter as 85,927, equal to the 2023Q1 'Rylaze' figure, so the rename is one continuous line.
